primary_metric: Whole account daily NAV Sharpe Rf=0 over mechanically maximal common history; separately retain QQQ inception full history
primary_threshold: Pure single-indicator next-open candidate must strictly exceed highest six current curated controls on identical common dates. Any apparent win is provisional pending complete eligible frontier and dividend/source/forward validation.
mechanism: Short-horizon overreaction in QQQ; oversold short RSI or close near session low forecasts reversal.

candidates.rule: Cutler simple 3-change RSI <10 enter; held maintain if RSI<=40, otherwise exit. No trend filter.
(close-low)/(high-low)<=0.2: next-session 100% target; otherwise cash. Consecutive signals retain position.
Latent RSI base position AND IBS<=0.5. RSI base held state persists through IBS veto; this is an auxiliary two-indicator reference.

edge_cases.rsi_warmup: first valid after 3 changes; warmup cash; no pre-inception prices

controls: Three unchanged rules at next-close clock
All six current curated product strategies via unchanged Swift runtime
funded_start: 1999-03-10 initial cash close baseline; no same-date trade. First eligible signal is known prior NYSE session. Full QQQ end 2026-10-02 from fetched complete file.
comparison_start: Intersection of daily states across all 14 continuously run accounts; no performance-based date choice
clock: Previous actual NYSE session close -> next actual NYSE session open; explicit open quotes. Close clock is diagnostic, not selected after results.
exposure: 100% single QQQ or RMB cash; no leverage/short/financing or constant cash dilution
price_policy: Yahoo split-adjusted OHLC undone before effective split. Simulator doubles units 2000-03-20. Signal-only index applies splits effective as of signal day; no adjusted-close dividends.
fx_policy: Original App FX unchanged after its first date. Earlier FRED DEXCHUS appended inverted; strict-prior date within 14 days used for open/close. No same-session close FX in opening fill.
falsification: Hand vectors distinguish Cutler RSI from Wilder and latent IBS filtering
All saved desired vs accepted targets, actual asset sets, units, historical denomination splits and quotes independently audited
No parameter rescue or branch reinterpretation after results
multiple_testing: All 3 rules and 2 clocks retained. Existing public-rule and project history exposed; no untouched holdout, no complete G3 count certified.
limitations: Price-only exploratory replay omits dividends and withholding tax; current Yahoo/FRED snapshots not certified vintages.
Prior-calendar FX closes lack separate UTC release timestamps or a funded USD wallet; opening auction all-in availability not broker verified.
Native product benchmarks are index/gold proxies with native next-close, distinct from QQQ auction timing.
Rf0 cash-only Sharpe diagnostic cannot qualify.
No formal G0-G6 pass, new product registration or promotion.
